data.label:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
foreach ($p in @(
 'D:\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\S1977LevelwiseRealificationActual.lean',
 'D:\lean\.lake\build\lib\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\S1977LevelwiseRealificationActual.olean',
 'D:\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\_S1977Consumer.lean',
 'D:\lean\.lake\build\lib\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\_S1977Consumer.olean',
 'D:\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\logs\S1977_report.md')) {
  if (Test-Path $p) { $i = Get-Item $p; Write-Output ($i.Name + ' | bytes=' + $i.Length + ' | sha256=' + (Get-FileHash $p -Algorithm SHA256).Hash) } else { Write-Output ('MISSING ' + $p) }
}
Write-Output '--- ledger tail ---'
Get-Content D:\lean\AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Tail 8
Write-Output ('--- ledger lines: ' + (Get-Content D:\lean\AUDIT_LEDGER.md | Measure-Object).Count)
Write-Output '--- src lines/bytes ---'
Write-Output ((Get-Content D:\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\S1977LevelwiseRealificationActual.lean | Measure-Object).Count)
Write-Output '--- final recompile (exit code only) ---'
lake env lean tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1977LevelwiseRealificationActual.lean > $null 2>&1
Write-Output ('FINAL_EXIT=' + $LASTEXITCODE)
